gaps.title: Missing Analytics Export Endpoint
gaps.jtbd: When I view the analytics dashboard, I want to export the utilization statistics to a file or EIOS, so that I can use them in educational center reports.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an admin user, When they request an analytics export, Then the system generates and returns a CSV/PDF report containing search queries, views, and downloads, or triggers an EIOS sync.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'экспорт статистики использования базы знаний (популярные запросы, просмотры, скачивания)' and 'выгрузка в ЭИОС и в отчёты образовательного центра'.

gaps.title: Missing Backup Mechanism
gaps.jtbd: When I perform administrative duties, I want to trigger a system backup, so that I can ensure data safety and recover from failures.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an admin user, When they trigger a backup, Then the backend creates and securely stores a snapshot of the database and uploaded files.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Администратор: ... резервное копирование'. The frontend currently simulates a backup with a timeout, but the backend lacks the actual implementation.

gaps.title: Unified Search Excludes LMS Metadata
gaps.jtbd: When I search the knowledge base, I want the results to include indexed materials from LMS platforms (SDO/Teachbase), so that I can find all relevant educational content.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a search query, When the user executes a search, Then the backend searches both local KbDocuments and synchronized LmsMetadata, returning a unified set of results.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'Поиск: Единый поиск по базе знаний + индексация материалов SDO/Teachbase (по метаданным).' Currently, searchDocuments only queries KbDocument.

gaps.title: Broken Text Extraction for Binary Files
gaps.jtbd: When I upload a binary document like a PDF or DOCX, I want its text to be correctly extracted, so that full-text search can match against its actual content.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a binary file upload, When the backend processes it, Then it uses an appropriate parser (e.g., Apache Tika) to extract text, rather than simply casting raw bytes to a UTF-8 string.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: 'полнотекстовый поиск ... поддержка файлов: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX'. Using new String(file.getBytes(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8) on binary files produces garbage, silently breaking the full-text search requirement.

gaps.title: Missing Pagination Metadata in Search Response
gaps.jtbd: When I request a paginated list of documents, I want to receive the total count of matching items, so that the client UI can correctly render pagination controls.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a paginated search request, When the backend returns results, Then the response payload includes total elements and total pages alongside the items array.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Paginated list endpoints typically need to return total counts (e.g., via a standard Page<T> response) so the UI knows how many pages exist.
